messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Write a practical notice for a fictional neighborhood repair cafe: bring one broken item, take a numbered ticket, and collect it before volunteers leave. Avoid promotional language. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: Please bring exactly one broken household item for repair. Upon arrival, proceed to the registration desk to receive a numbered ticket. This number determines your place in the queue and must be kept safe. Repairs are conducted by volunteer experts on a first-come, first-served basis. You must collect your item before the volunteers depart at 4:00 PM. Unclaimed items will not be stored overnight. Please ensure you have enough time to wait for your turn. We cannot guarantee repairs for all devices. Thank you for cooperating with these simple procedures to ensure smooth operations for everyone attending today’s session.
